name: M3_PMS100MI_RelHeldMO
description: Release a held manufacturing order so that it returns to normal planning and execution. This operation reactivates an order that was previously placed on short‑term or long‑term hold. You identify the order by facility, product number, and manufacturing order number. During release you can optionally update the planned start or finish date and time so the order is rescheduled as it becomes active again, and you can choose to also reschedule dependent lower‑level orders created from the bill of material explosion.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the held manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number of the manufactured item on the held manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number of the held order to release.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number that owns the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: New planned start date for the manufacturing order when it is released.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: New planned start time for the manufacturing order when it is released.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: New planned finish date for the manufacturing order when it is released.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: New planned finish time for the manufacturing order when it is released.

inputParameters.name: RPLL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether lower-level orders created by explosion should also be rescheduled when releasing the manufacturing order.
